description: PokeAPI's Dragon type: every Dragon Pokémon's official artwork, which generation it came from, and the type chart: what Dragon hits hard and what hits it back. Statistics: a rate needs an exposure. Later generations look Dragon-heavy, but each brought a different number of new species, so the count is divided by that size and shown with a 95% interval (the generation sizes are the national Pokédex ranges, written into the step; alternate forms are left out). Next: the table's links lead to each Pokémon's own stats (base stats are a step away, one call per Pokémon).
name: Dragon-type Pokémon
